## URL Parser

<div class="tool-meta"><span class="engine-native">native</span><span>live</span></div>

Break a URL into scheme, host, port, path, query parameters and fragment, with IDN/punycode forms.

```sh
dogubako network url-parse <url>
```

Id `network.url_parse` · MCP `network_url_parse` · Output: structured data · Timeout 2 min

Also found by: url, uri, query string, punycode, idn, decode, parse

| Option | CLI | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `url` *(required)* | positional | text |  |  |

## URL Normalizer

<div class="tool-meta"><span class="engine-native">native</span><span>live</span></div>

Canonicalize URLs: lowercase scheme/host, drop default ports, resolve dot segments, sort query, strip tracking parameters.

```sh
dogubako network url-normalize <urls> [options]
```

Id `network.url_normalize` · MCP `network_url_normalize` · Output: text (`text/plain`) · Timeout 2 min

Also found by: url, canonical, clean, utm, tracking, fbclid, gclid, normalize

| Option | CLI | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `urls` *(required)* | positional | text (multi-line) |  | One URL per line. |
| `remove_tracking` | `--remove-tracking` | boolean | `true` | Remove tracking parameters (utm\_\*, fbclid, gclid…). |
| `sort_query` | `--sort-query` | boolean | `true` | Sort query parameters. |
| `remove_fragment` | `--remove-fragment` | boolean | `false` | Remove #fragment. |
| `remove_www` | `--remove-www` | boolean | `false` | Remove leading www. *Advanced.* |
| `strip_trailing_slash` | `--strip-trailing-slash` | boolean | `false` | Strip trailing slash from path. *Advanced.* |
| `remove_empty_params` | `--remove-empty-params` | boolean | `false` | Remove parameters with empty values. *Advanced.* |

## Query Parameter Editor

<div class="tool-meta"><span class="engine-native">native</span><span>live</span></div>

Set, replace or remove URL query parameters and rebuild the URL.

```sh
dogubako network query-params <url> [options]
```

Id `network.query_params` · MCP `network_query_params` · Output: text (`text/plain`) · Timeout 2 min

Also found by: url, query, parameters, querystring, edit, builder

| Option | CLI | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `url` *(required)* | positional | text |  |  |
| `set` | `--set` | text (multi-line) |  | JSON object ({"q": "x", "tag": ["a","b"], "drop": null}) or one key=value per line; replaces existing values. |
| `remove` | `--remove` | text |  | Comma-separated keys; supports a trailing \* wildcard (utm\_\*). |
| `clear` | `--clear` | boolean | `false` | Remove all existing parameters first. *Advanced.* |

## CIDR Calculator

<div class="tool-meta"><span class="engine-native">native</span><span>live</span></div>

Subnet calculator for IPv4/IPv6: network, broadcast, netmask, host range; contains-check, split into subnets, aggregate CIDR lists.

```sh
dogubako network cidr <cidr> [options]
```

Id `network.cidr` · MCP `network_cidr` · Output: structured data · Timeout 2 min

Also found by: cidr, subnet, netmask, calculator, ipv4, ipv6, supernet, aggregate, summarize, wildcard

| Option | CLI | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `cidr` *(required)* | positional | text (multi-line) |  | One per line, e.g. 10.0.0.0/22, 2001:db8::/48 or 192.168.1.0 255.255.255.0. |
| `action` | `--action` | choice | `info` | One of: `info` (Subnet details), `contains` (Does it contain an address?), `split` (Split into subnets), `summarize` (Summarize / aggregate list). |
| `address` | `--address` | text |  | Address or CIDR to test. Only used when `action` is `contains`. |
| `new_prefix` | `--new-prefix` | integer 0–128 | `26` | New prefix length. Only used when `action` is `split`. |


Id `network.cert_decode` · MCP `network_cert_decode` · Output: structured data · Timeout 2 min

| Option | CLI | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `pem` | positional | text (multi-line) |  | Paste one or more -----BEGIN CERTIFICATE----- / CERTIFICATE REQUEST blocks. |
| `file` | `--file` | file |  | …or certificate file. Accepts .pem .crt .cer .der .csr .req .p7b. |

## Key Inspector

<div class="tool-meta"><span class="engine-native">native</span><span>live</span></div>

Identify public/private keys (PEM, PKCS#1/#8, SEC1, OpenSSH, SSH public keys): type, size, curve and SHA-256 fingerprints — private key material is never echoed.

```sh

```

Id `network.key_inspect` · MCP `network_key_inspect` · Output: structured data · Timeout 2 min

Also found by: key, public key, private key, rsa, ecdsa, ed25519, ssh, fingerprint, pem, pkcs8, spki

| Option | CLI | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `key` | `--key` | secret |  | PEM block(s) or SSH public key line(s). Processed locally; not stored or echoed. |
| `file` | `--file` | file |  | …or key file. Accepts .pem .key .pub .der .crt .txt. |

## DNS Lookup

<div class="tool-meta"><span class="engine-network">network</span><span>network</span></div>

Query DNS records (A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, NS, SOA, CAA, SRV, PTR, HTTPS…) with TTLs via the system or a public resolver (optionally DNS-over-HTTPS).

```sh
dogubako network dns-lookup <name> [options]
```

Id `network.dns_lookup` · MCP `network_dns_lookup` · Output: structured data · Timeout 1 min

Also found by: dns, dig, nslookup, mx, txt, spf, dmarc, ns, soa, caa, records, resolver, doh

| Option | CLI | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` *(required)* | positional | text |  | Domain name or IP. |
| `types` | `--types` | list of choices | `A,AAAA,CNAME,MX,TXT,NS,SOA,CAA` | Record types. Any of: `A`, `AAAA`, `CNAME`, `MX`, `TXT`, `NS`, `SOA`, `CAA`, `SRV`, `PTR`, `HTTPS`, `DS`, `DNSKEY`, `TLSA`, `NAPTR`. |
| `resolver` | `--resolver` | choice | `system` | One of: `system` (System resolver), `cloudflare` (Cloudflare 1.1.1.1), `google` (Google 8.8.8.8), `quad9` (Quad9 9.9.9.9), `cloudflare-doh` (Cloudflare (DNS-over-HTTPS)), `google-doh` (Google (DNS-over-HTTPS)), `quad9-doh` (Quad9 (DNS-over-HTTPS)). |

| `timeout_ms` | `--timeout-ms` | integer 100–15000 | `3000` | Timeout per attempt (ms). *Advanced.* |

## Port Checker

<div class="tool-meta"><span class="engine-network">network</span><span>network</span><span>progress</span></div>

Check which TCP ports are open on a host (common services or up to 50 listed ports) with short timeouts and bounded concurrency.

```sh
dogubako network port-check <host> [options]
```

Id `network.port_check` · MCP `network_port_check` · Output: structured data · Timeout 2 min

Also found by: port, open port, tcp, firewall, port check, service, listening

| Option | CLI | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `host` *(required)* | positional | text |  |  |
| `preset` | `--preset` | choice | `common` | One of: `common` (Common service ports (25)), `custom` (Custom list). |
| `ports` | `--ports` | text |  | e.g. 22,80,443,8000-8010 (max 50). Only used when `preset` is `custom`. |
| `timeout_ms` | `--timeout-ms` | integer 100–5000 | `1500` | Windows retries refused connections for about 2 s, so shorter timeouts there report closed ports as filtered. *Advanced.* |
